carousels.name: 4 differences between guilt and shame when quitting p*rn

slides.title: 4 differences between guilt and shame [[when you're quitting p*rn.]]
slides.sub: One helps you change. One keeps you stuck.

slides.title: Guilt says "I [[did]] bad"
slides.body: Shame says "I [[am]] bad." Guilt is about the action. Shame is about who you are.

slides.title: Guilt [[moves]] you
slides.body: It pushes you to fix things. Shame freezes you — and often sends you back to p*rn.

slides.title: Differences [[3–4]]
items: Guilt learns from a slip. Shame repeats it.

slides.title: Turn shame into [[guilt]]
items: Separate the act from yourself: "I watched p*rn" — not "I'm disgusting."
Tell one person. Shame shrinks when shared.
